small = [
    "zero",
    "one",
    "two",
    "three",
    "four",
    "five",
    "six",
    "seven",
    "eight",
    "nine",
    "ten",
    "eleven",
    "twelve",
    "thirteen",
    "fourteen",
    "fifteen",
    "sixteen",
    "seventeen",
    "eighteen",
    "nineteen",
]
tens = [
    "",
    "",
    "twenty",
    "thirty",
    "forty",
    "fifty",
    "sixty",
    "seventy",
    "eighty",
    "ninety",
]


def under_thousand(value):
    parts = []
    if value >= 100:
        parts.append(small[value // 100] + " hundred")
    remainder = value % 100
    if remainder >= 20:
        word = tens[remainder // 10]
        if remainder % 10:
            word += "-" + small[remainder % 10]
        parts.append(word)
    elif remainder:
        parts.append(small[remainder])
    return " ".join(parts)


for number in [0, 13, 40, 100, 568, 71000, 300019, 999999]:
    parts = []
    if number >= 1000:
        parts.append(under_thousand(number // 1000) + " thousand")
    if number % 1000:
        parts.append(under_thousand(number % 1000))
    words = " ".join(parts) if parts else small[0]
    print(f"{number}: {words}")
